application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Details pursuant to condition NS10 -ecological enhancements, of planning permission PA25/3446.
decision_conditions:
The compliance conponent of this condition (NS10 below) hereby approved remains in full force, 'the development shall not be implemented other than in accordance with the approved scheme, which shall be implemented in full prior to the first occupation of the development'.

NS10 Ecological Enhancements 
Within 4 weeks of the date of this decision, exact details of the location (height and relation to windows) of integrated features (bird and bat boxes) and timing of implementation shall be submitted for approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be implemented other than in accordance with the approved scheme, which shall be implemented in full prior to the first occupation of the development.
